description:
Use this when the user asks which cards in one game are at a record price.
    Returns cards that set their highest market price since TickerMint began tracking
    the game (February 2024 for Pokemon, One Piece and Lorcana; later for the others,
    see `tracked_since`) in the last 7 days and still hold it, with the date of the
    high, in USD. For a card released before that day it is not an all-time high:
    each card's `high_is_all_time` and `high_scope` say which it is.
